headline: CIN @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 3.87 at PIT 4.31, with a projected total of 8.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PIT: CIN moved -0.51 runs while PIT moved +0.12, changing the projected margin by -0.63 runs. The projected total fell -0.40, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +21.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Andrew Abbott has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bryan Reynolds, Brandon Lowe, Nick Gonzales, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Eugenio Suárez, Matt McLain because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
